name: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken for Vehicle Purchase through Banks
benefit: - 6% interest subsidy on bank loans for vehicle purchase. - Loan eligibility range: ₹5,00,000 to ₹20,00,000.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of tribal areas in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have taken a bank loan specifically for vehicle purchase.
